reason: The README describes a chat plugin that converts uploaded or referenced images into OCR text and optional vision-model descriptions so text-only models can understand them.

summaries.zh: 将聊天中的图片通过本地 OCR 和可选的视觉语言模型转换为文本，并注入文本模型上下文以辅助理解。
summaries.en: Converts chat images into text using local OCR and an optional vision-language model, then adds the results to the text model's context.

capabilities: Reads local image files or image URLs for processing
Sends image data and user questions to a configured external vision-language model API
Injects OCR and vision results into text-model context
Stores or caches image-analysis results and configuration data
